ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 85% high-intensity (off-white/cream) pixels and 15% low-intensity (black/dark brown) pixels localized primarily at the margins and base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central contiguous regions on both lobes; low-intensity black perimeter banding along the leading and trailing edges; dense clusters of dark pixels (mottling) near the peduncle junction and scattered across the interior of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across both lobes; right lobe exhibits deeper, more jagged pixel-amplitude valleys compared to the left; continuous linear boundary transition from white fluke to dark water background shows fine-scale jaggedness (1-5 pixel depth).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the distal trailing edges transitioning to convex curvature at the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of high-intensity, yellowish-white roughly circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible across the central white portions of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe suggests previous tissue loss; calcified barnacle colonization on the right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct isolated dark circular focal point on the right lobe approximately two-thirds of the way toward the tip.
